policy.full_panel_rule: all six complete; neither Genre64 nor any Genre W1 channel worsens beyond numerical tolerance; at least one state improves BOTH Genre64 and a Genre W1 channel
policy.mixed_rule: any independent metric deterioration => tradeoff, not overall success
policy.unresolved_rule: no resolved independent gain => no evidence of gain; not equivalence
policy.failure_rule: missing/binding/numerical error or timeout => incomplete/protocol failure; never declare success from subset
policy.meaning: descriptive frozen-state evidence only, no generated-graph quality claim
